notes: Read SKILL.md and references/keys.md, references/secrets.md in full. The skill is an SDK reference for @azure/keyvault-keys (and @azure/keyvault-secrets) in TypeScript: authentication, key create/rotate/delete/backup, CryptographyClient encrypt/sign/wrap, and secret CRUD, soft delete and purge.

The only command is the Installation block `npm install @azure/keyvault-keys @azure/identity` (official Microsoft packages); everything else is sample code for the user's application with placeholder vault names, key/secret names and values. The skill does not instruct the agent to access a real vault, read, print or transmit secrets, or run delete/purge operations itself.

Some samples print secret values (SKILL.md:69, secrets.md:115), export every enabled secret value into a map (secrets.md:406-419), write a secret backup blob to a local file (secrets.md:302-303), and show irreversible purge calls (SKILL.md:98, 163; keys.md:273; secrets.md:279-286); these are user-code patterns that users should adapt carefully. SKILL.md uses SecretClient (line 45) while installing only @azure/keyvault-keys, so @azure/keyvault-secrets must also be installed for those samples.
